1.outline: Term theme: 'Capstone — Website, Portfolio & AI'. Write a precise brief for a capstone site, then plan its structure exactly to that brief.
1.sowResources: Printed brief template, example capstone site.
objectives: Write a precise, examiner-style brief for a website.
Plan a site structure that exactly matches the brief.
Justify each planned page against the brief.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Precise briefs
plan.detail: Recap the IGCSE habit: a brief should be specific and checkable.

plan.title: Write and plan
plan.detail: Write a brief for the capstone site, then plan pages that meet it exactly.

plan.title: Justify
plan.detail: Justify each planned page against a line in the brief. Log out.

successCriteria: My brief is specific and checkable.
My site plan matches every instruction in the brief.
I justified each page against the brief.

2.outline: Build the site's page structure and navigation menu exactly to the brief, checking every page is reachable.
objectives: Build the planned pages.
Set up a working navigation menu.
Check every page is reachable from the menu.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Build structure
plan.detail: Build the planned pages and set up the navigation menu.

plan.title: Reachability check
plan.detail: Check every page is reachable from the menu. Save and log out.

successCriteria: My site has the planned pages built.
My navigation menu works.
Every page is reachable from the menu.

3.outline: Add media (images, embedded video or slides) and a data element (a table or chart) to the site.
objectives: Add media to the site.
Add a data table or chart.
Check both display correctly.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Add media
plan.detail: Add images and an embedded video or slide deck to relevant pages.

plan.title: Add data
plan.detail: Add a table or chart of relevant data to a page.

plan.title: Save
plan.detail: Save and log out.

activities: Add a data table or chart
successCriteria: My site includes added media.
My site includes a data table or chart.
Both display correctly.

4.outline: Under teacher guidance, build a genuinely useful tool or game with an AI tool, related to the site's purpose.
objectives: Use a guided AI tool to build a useful tool or game.
Ensure it relates to the site's purpose.
Test that it works.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Build with AI
plan.detail: Under supervision, build a tool or game that supports the site's purpose.

plan.title: Test it
plan.detail: Test the tool works as intended.

plan.title: Save
plan.detail: Save and log out.

successCriteria: I built a tool or game with the guided AI tool.
It relates clearly to my site's purpose.
I tested that it works.

5.outline: IGCSE-style theory: the systems life cycle, and safety/security considerations for a real website.
5.sowResources: IGCSE ICT 0417 theory notes, discussion cards.
objectives: Outline the stages of the systems life cycle.
Name one safety and one security consideration for a website.
Apply one consideration to the capstone site.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Systems life cycle
plan.detail: Outline the stages: analysis, design, development, testing, implementation, evaluation.

plan.title: Safety and security
plan.detail: Discuss one safety issue (e.g. inappropriate content) and one security issue (e.g. weak passwords) relevant to websites.

plan.title: Apply it
plan.detail: Apply one consideration to the capstone site. Log out.

successCriteria: I can outline the systems life cycle stages.
I named a safety and a security consideration.
I applied one consideration to my own site.

6.outline: Discuss the effects of ICT on society — jobs, communication, health, environment — and write a short reflection.
6.sowResources: IGCSE ICT 0417 theory notes, discussion cards.
objectives: Discuss positive and negative effects of ICT on society.
Consider effects relevant to the capstone site's topic.
Write a short reflection.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Effects discussion
plan.detail: Discuss ICT's effects: jobs, communication, health, environment — positives and negatives.

plan.title: Relate to the site
plan.detail: Discuss which effects are relevant to the capstone site's topic.

plan.title: Write it up
plan.detail: Write a short reflection paragraph. Log out.

successCriteria: I discussed positive and negative effects of ICT.
I related at least one effect to my site's topic.
I wrote a short reflection paragraph.

7.outline: Finalise the capstone site, publish it, and curate it alongside the year's best work into a complete portfolio.
7.sowResources: Google Sites / HTML editor, portfolio folder.
objectives: Finalise and publish the capstone site.
Curate the year's best work into the portfolio.
Check everything is correctly named and organised.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Finalise and publish
plan.detail: Do a final check and publish the capstone site.

plan.title: Curate the portfolio
plan.detail: Gather the year's best work into the portfolio folder, correctly named.

plan.title: Log out
plan.detail: Log out.

successCriteria: My capstone site is finalised and published.
My portfolio includes the year's best work.
Everything is correctly named and organised.

8.outline: Present the finished capstone site and portfolio to the class, reflecting on readiness for IGCSE ICT.
objectives: Present the finished capstone site and portfolio.
Reflect on readiness for IGCSE ICT.
Save the presentation to the portfolio.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Present
plan.detail: Present the capstone site and portfolio to the class.

plan.title: IGCSE readiness reflection
plan.detail: Discuss: which skills am I taking into IGCSE ICT?

plan.title: Save
plan.detail: Save the presentation notes to the portfolio folder. Log out.

successCriteria: I presented my finished capstone site and portfolio.
I reflected on my readiness for IGCSE ICT.
My presentation notes are saved to the portfolio folder.

9.outline: Add a reflection page to the site summarising the systems life cycle and effects-of-ICT theory learned this term.
objectives: Summarise the systems life cycle in a page.
Summarise one effect of ICT discussed this term.
Re-publish the site.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Build the reflection page
plan.detail: Summarise the systems life cycle and one effect of ICT on a new page.

plan.title: Re-publish
plan.detail: Add the page and re-publish the site.

plan.title: Save
plan.detail: Save and log out.

successCriteria: My reflection page summarises the systems life cycle.
My reflection page summarises one effect of ICT.
My re-published site works correctly.

10.outline: Rehearse the term's skills in pairs: build to a brief, add an AI element, and recall one theory point.
objectives: Recall the term's practical and theory skills.
Rehearse building to a brief with a partner.
Recall one theory point clearly.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Skill and theory recap
plan.detail: Recap: brief, structure, AI, safety/security, effects of ICT — as a class chant.

plan.title: Paired rehearsal
plan.detail: Build a short page to a mini-brief with a partner reading the task card, then swap.

plan.title: Theory recall check
plan.detail: Recall one theory point out loud. Log out.

successCriteria: I can list the term's practical and theory skills.
I rehearsed building to a brief with a partner.
I recalled one theory point clearly.

11.outline: Individual task: build to an IGCSE-style brief, publish the capstone site with an AI element, and answer a short theory question.
objectives: Author a website to a given brief.
Include a working AI tool/game.
Answer a short theory question correctly.

plan.title: Settle and explain
plan.detail: Calm start — explain the task.

plan.title: Build to the brief
plan.detail: Individual practical: build and publish site content to the given brief.

plan.title: Theory question
plan.detail: Answer a short written theory question on systems or effects of ICT.

plan.title: Celebrate
plan.detail: Save and celebrate the year's progress. Log out.

successCriteria: My build follows the given brief closely.
My AI tool/game works correctly.
I answered the theory question correctly.

12.outline: Plan a final, polished capstone piece that could stand as an IGCSE coursework sample: precise, complete, well-documented.
objectives: Plan a final polish pass against IGCSE-style standards.
Identify gaps against the rubric.
Plan how to close each gap.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Rubric gap analysis
plan.detail: Compare the current site against the IGCSE-style rubric and list every gap.

plan.title: Plan the fixes
plan.detail: Plan how to close each gap. Collect plans. Log out.

successCriteria: My plan lists every gap against the rubric.
My plan shows how to close each gap.
My plan is realistic for three lessons.

13.outline: Close the gaps identified against the rubric, polishing the site and the AI element.
objectives: Close the identified rubric gaps.
Polish the site's structure and content.
Re-test the AI element.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Close the gaps
plan.detail: Work through the gap list, fixing each one.

plan.title: Re-test
plan.detail: Re-test the AI element still works. Save and log out.

successCriteria: I closed the gaps identified against the rubric.
My site content is polished.
My AI element still works correctly.

14.outline: Final rubric self-check, re-publish the polished capstone site, and rehearse a client-style presentation.
14.sowResources: Google Sites / HTML editor, IGCSE-style rubric.
objectives: Do a final rubric self-check.
Re-publish the polished site.
Rehearse a client-style presentation.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Final rubric check
plan.detail: Self-mark the site against the rubric one more time.

plan.title: Re-publish
plan.detail: Re-publish the polished site.

plan.title: Rehearse
plan.detail: Practise a client-style presentation with a partner. Log out.

successCriteria: My site passed a final rubric self-check.
My polished site is re-published.
I rehearsed a client-style presentation.

15.outline: Present the finished capstone site to the class as if to a real client, and save the whole year's portfolio, ready for IGCSE.
15.sowResources: Class projector, client-brief sheet, portfolio folder.
objectives: Present the finished capstone site confidently, client-style.
Explain the site, the AI tool and the theory behind it.
Save the whole year's portfolio, ready for IGCSE.

plan.title: Final rehearsal
plan.detail: One last run-through with a partner before presenting.

plan.title: Client Demo Day
plan.detail: Present capstone sites to the class as if to a real client, in small groups.

plan.title: Portfolio save
plan.detail: Save the finished site and review the whole year's portfolio folder.

plan.title: IGCSE-ready reflection
plan.detail: Reflect on readiness for IGCSE ICT 0417. Log out.

successCriteria: I presented my capstone site confidently, client-style.
I explained my site, AI tool and the theory behind it.
My whole year's work is saved, ready for IGCSE.
